# Northwind Logistics -- Statement of Work

Halvard Systems (Customer) and Northwind Logistics (Vendor) enter into this Statement of Work for freight brokerage and supply-chain visibility services. The document is fictional and was generated for NorthForge testing; it records no real commercial relationship.

## Term and Renewal

This Statement of Work has a fixed term that begins on 2026-07-16 and expires on 2028-07-16. It does not renew automatically. Halvard Systems and Northwind Logistics may extend the term only by a written amendment executed at least forty-five (45) days before expiry.

## Termination

Halvard Systems may terminate this Statement of Work for convenience at any time on thirty (30) days written notice. Either party may terminate for cause where a material breach remains uncured thirty (30) days after notice, and Northwind Logistics shall return or delete Customer materials on termination.

## Payment Terms

Northwind Logistics invoices Halvard Systems monthly in arrears. Undisputed invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of receipt, and late undisputed amounts accrue interest at two percent (2%) per month.

## Governing Law

The laws of the State of New York govern this Statement of Work and any dispute between Halvard Systems and Northwind Logistics arising out of it. Proceedings shall be brought only in the courts of the State of New York.

## Notices

Contractual notices are delivered electronically: Halvard Systems receives notices at contracts@halvard.example.com and Northwind Logistics at contracts@northwind.example.com. A notice is deemed received on the next business day after transmission.

## Signatures

Executed by Tobias Renner (Head of Vendor Management) for Halvard Systems and by Ines Calloway (Chief Revenue Officer) for Northwind Logistics. The signatories are fictional characters created for this synthetic corpus.
